description.value: Sage Hills Motel is a single-storey roadside motel situated on the Cariboo Highway (Highway 97) in the V0K1H0 postal area, a stretch of road that forms a key artery for cyclists touring through BC's interior plateau. Its location along this remote corridor makes it a potentially important overnight stop for self-supported tourers covering long distances between services. The area is known for its high-desert sagebrush landscape and sparse amenity infrastructure.
